description: This file contains implementation code for an mbedTLS-based SSL client within the libwebsockets library. It manages SSL context creation, peer certificate verification, and the establishment of TLS client connections, including handling of certificates, private keys, ALPN, and hostname verification.

methods.name: int lws_mbedtls_client_verify_callback(SSL * ssl,mbedtls_x509_crt * x509)
methods.description: Callback invoked for each peer certificate to extract and store AKID and SKID information into the ssl->kid_chain.

methods.name: int lws_ssl_client_bio_create(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Initializes SSL object for the client connection, sets hostname, ALPN, certificate authentication parameters, and prepares the SSL context for connection.

methods.name: int ERR_get_error(void)
methods.description: Dummy function to satisfy SSL error retrieval, always returns 0.

methods.name: enum:lws_ssl_capable_status lws_tls_client_connect(struct lws * wsi,char * errbuf,size_t elen)
methods.description: Performs the TLS client handshake, handles different error and state conditions, and establishes a TLS connection.

methods.name: int lws_tls_client_confirm_peer_cert(struct lws * wsi,char * ebuf,size_t ebuf_len)
methods.description: Verifies the server's peer certificate after the handshake, handles validation errors, and logs metrics.

methods.name: int lws_tls_client_create_vhost_context(struct lws_vhost * vh,const struct lws_context_creation_info * info,const char * cipher_list,const char * ca_filepath,const void * ca_mem,unsigned int ca_mem_len,const char * cert_filepath,const void * cert_mem,unsigned int cert_mem_len,const char * private_key_filepath,const void * key_mem,unsigned int key_mem_len)
methods.description: Configures and creates an SSL context for a virtual host, loading CA certificates, client certificates, and private keys from file or memory.

methods.name: int lws_tls_client_vhost_extra_cert_mem(struct lws_vhost * vh,const uint8_t * der,size_t der_len)
methods.description: Adds an additional ASN.1 encoded CA certificate to the SSL context for validation.
